prompt:
I'm adding Amharic to our delivery app. Translate this en.json into am.json with the same keys, keep the {placeholders} working. Write the file am.json.

{
  "save": "Save",
  "cancel": "Cancel",
  "delete_confirm": "Delete {name}? This can't be undone.",
  "files_count": "{count} files",
  "welcome_back": "Welcome back, {firstName}!",
  "search_placeholder": "Search orders…",
  "error_network": "Can't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.",
  "order_delivered": "Your order was delivered at {time}."
}
assertions: am.json is valid JSON with exactly the eight keys of en.json
Every placeholder ({name}, {count}, {firstName}, {time}) appears unchanged in its string in am.json
Every value in am.json is Amharic in Fidel script, none left in English
The sentence strings in am.json use Ethiopic punctuation (። or ?) with no :: and no space before ። or ፣
welcome_back uses a polite or gender-neutral greeting (e.g. መጡ), not the informal መጣህ or መጣሽ
